japan1.title: 米就業者 市場予想に反し減少 利上げ観測後退で円高ドル安進む

ca3.description: A Toronto rapper convicted of two counts of second-degree murder in the shootings of two young women at a Fort Erie, Ont., house party will spend 22 years in prison before he's eligible for parole. Christine Crooks of Toronto and Juliana Pannunzio of Windsor were killed in January 2021.

ca3.title: Blue Jays pitcher Bieber out with shoulder injury in midst of playoff push
ca3.description: The Toronto Blue Jays have placed right-handed pitcher Shane Bieber on the 15-day injured list with inflammation of his right teres major muscle.

ca3.title: First Nations businesses, communities brace for Canada-U.S. trade war
ca3.description: First Nations are grappling with uncertainty and bracing for impact as the Canada-U.S. trade war escalates, with steep tariffs taking effect on some business sectors.

ca3.title: N.L. premier reaching out to 'key industry partners' as trade war ramps up
ca3.description: N.L. political leaders are commenting on the latest in the Canada-U.S. trade dispute.

ca3.title: Former Alberta premier Jason Kenney calls on province to take tougher approach to U.S. trade war
ca3.description: Speaking on CBC Radio's Calgary Eyeopener Tuesday morning, the former United Conservative Party leader said export taxes on the province's energy resources should be on the table to put additional pressure on U.S. President Donald Trump.

ca3.title: What would help health care in the N.W.T.'s Dehcho? Residents say it’s about relationships
ca3.description: A recent set of recommendations on improving health care in the region focuses on staffing and equipment but what matters most, some residents say, is relationships. The recommendations follow a months-long investigation into the deaths of three Dehcho residents in early 2025.

ca3.title: Text messages in murder plea show killer and friend plotted to lure, confine, rape Calgary women
ca3.description: A Calgary courtroom was completely silent Monday but for the subdued voice of a prosecutor as she read aloud chilling and depraved text messages between two men who plotted to lure, confine and rape women so they could film their crimes and make money from the videos.

ca3.title: Trump threatens to rename Lake Ontario 'Lake America' as trade feud heats up
ca3.description: In an early morning tweet Tuesday, U.S. President Donald Trump threatened to rename Lake Ontario to "Lake America," following a breakdown in trade negotiations and a comment Monday from Ontario Premier Doug Ford inviting the president to "kiss my ass."

ca3.title: Liberals announce $7.5B in tariff support, detail $26.7B in counter-tariffs on U.S.
ca3.description: Days after the collapse of trade talks with the Trump administration, the Liberal government is rolling out $7.5 billion to help workers and businesses weather the new 50 per cent tariffs being imposed on $27.6 billion of Canadian goods by the U.S. president.

ca3.title: Halifax woman defrauded $1,200 after wallet stolen, thieves reportedly impersonated her bank
ca3.description: Candida Hadley's wallet was stolen from a north-end Halifax café. After that came the fraudulent phone calls that ended up costing her $1,200.

ca3.title: N.L.'s head of prisons out of role after 'financial irregularities' discovered at largest correctional facility
ca3.description: The head of prisons in Newfoundland and Labrador is no longer in the role and the province notified the auditor general amidst the discovery of "financial and administrative irregularities."

ca3.title: Victim of Prince George plane crash identified as devoted coach, volunteer and mother of 2
ca3.description: Alex Garneau was an athlete, coach and volunteer involved in many sports throughout Prince George, B.C.. The mother of two was killed when a plane made an emergency landing on a busy road, hitting her vehicle and three others. The investigation is ongoing.

ca3.title: Woman flagged by ID scanner as nationwide 'public safety concern' after incident in Winnipeg bar
ca3.description: Privacy experts are raising concerns after a Winnipeg bar flagged a woman as a nationwide public safety concern through its ID scanning system, which led to her being denied entry to a Calgary Stampede venue in July.

ca3.title: Paddler shoots and kills polar bear along Hudson Bay coast in Manitoba, province says
ca3.description: A paddler shot and killed a polar bear in northern Manitoba on Friday, in a rare Canadian example of a recreational traveller killing a member of the protected species.
